summary: Sometimes one meaningful opportunity gives you enough leverage to change the part of a situation you had almost accepted as permanent.
body: Sometimes one meaningful opportunity gives you enough leverage to change the part of a situation you had almost accepted as permanent. When Jupiter sextiles Pluto, growth and influence work together, making access, money, authority, or the support of the right person more useful than it would normally be. The opening matters because you can do more with it than simply improve appearances. Use the additional power on the condition that has been limiting your choices, especially if changing that one thing would leave you with more control after the opportunity passes.
